sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspected coordinated fraud involving customer C10326 and card C10326-K1. The transaction was initiated from the device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080', which was marked as a New device and routed through an anonymous proxy. The episode includes two prior online transactions on 2016-11-14, bringing the total exposure to $309.11. The activity is highly suspicious because the same fully specified device profile was used on 27 other cards belonging to 27 other customers between 2016-11-15 and 2016-12-02. Across the dataset, this device profile appeared on 52 cards, with 52 uses as a New device behind an anonymizing proxy. This indicates a coordinated effort to mask the true origin of the transactions, likely by a fraud ring.
